business_summary: Zhejiang Jinsheng New Materials Co.,Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of acrylic containers in China and internationally. It offers acrylic cream and lotion bottles, PETG jars, PP jars, and vacuum bottles products. The company was formerly known as Zhejiang Jinsheng Packaging Co.,Ltd and changed its name to Zhejiang Jinsheng New Materials Co., Ltd. in 2017. Zhejiang Jinsheng New Materials Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Shaoxing, China.

Zhejiang Jinsheng New Materials Co., Ltd.는 1998년에 설립되었으며 중국 소흥에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
